fields.title: ONE PIECE
fields.description: Monkey D. Luffy, a pirate with rubber powers, forms the Straw Hat crew and sails the Grand Line, battling rivals and the World Government on a quest for the legendary treasure One Piece and the title of Pirate King.

fields.title: MY HERO ACADEMIA
fields.description: A superhero-admiring boy enrolls in a prestigious hero academy and learns what it really means to be a hero, after the strongest superhero grants him his own powers.

fields.title: NARUTO
fields.description: Naruto Uzumaki, a mischievous adolescent ninja, struggles as he searches for recognition and dreams of becoming the Hokage, the village's leader and strongest ninja.

fields.title: SOLO LEVELING
fields.description: Follows the adventures of Sung Jinwoo in a world that is constantly threatened by monsters and evil forces. In his battles Sung transforms himself from the weakest hunter of all mankind to one of the strongest hunters in existence.

fields.title: BLEACH
fields.description: High school student Ichigo Kurosaki, who has the ability to see ghosts, gains soul reaper powers from Rukia Kuchiki and sets out to save the world from "Hollows".

fields.title: JUJUTSU KAISEN
fields.description: After Yuji Itadori swallows a cursed talisman - the finger of a demon - he becomes cursed himself. He enters a shaman's school to be able to locate the demon's other body parts and thus exorcise himself.

fields.title: ONE PUNCHMAN
fields.description: The story of Saitama, a hero that does it just for fun & can defeat his enemies with a single punch.

fields.title: DEMON SLAYER: Kimetsu no Yaiba
fields.description: A family is attacked by demons and only two members survive - Tanjiro and his sister Nezuko, who is turning into a demon slowly. Tanjiro sets out to become a demon slayer to avenge his family and cure his sister.

fields.title: DR. STONE
fields.description: High schooler Taiju awakens from petrification millennia after a blinding light turned humanity to stone. He finds his scientific genius friend Senku working on a plan to rebuild civilization using science.

fields.title: VINLAND SAGA
fields.description: Following a tragedy, Thorfinn embarks on a journey with the man responsible for it to take his life in a duel as a true and honorable warrior.

fields.title: HAIKYUU!!
fields.description: Determined to be like the volleyball championship's star player nicknamed "the small giant", Shoyo joins his school's volleyball club.

fields.title: HUNTER ✕ HUNTER
fields.description: Gon Freecss aspires to become a Hunter, an exceptional being capable of greatness. With his friends and his potential, he seeks out his father, who left him when he was younger.

fields.title: STEINS; GATE
fields.description: After discovering time travel, a university student and his colleagues must use their knowledge of it to stop an evil organization and their diabolical plans.

fields.title: BLACK CLOVER
fields.description: Asta and Yuno were abandoned together at the same church and have been inseparable since. As children, they promised that they would compete against each other to see who would become the next Emperor Magus.

fields.title: ATTACK ON TITAN
fields.description: In a world where humanity shelters behind towering walls from man-eating Titans, a determined teen joins the elite Survey Corps to fight the giants and uncover the secrets of their origin.

fields.title: CODE GEASS: Lelouch of the Rebellion
fields.description: After being given a mysterious power to control others, an outcast prince becomes the masked leader of the rebellion against an all-powerful empire.

fields.title: DEATH NOTE
fields.description: An intelligent high school student goes on a secret crusade to eliminate criminals from the world after discovering a notebook capable of killing anyone whose name is written into it.

fields.title: MOB PSYCHO 100
fields.description: A psychic middle school boy tries to live a normal life and keep his growing powers under control, even though he constantly gets into trouble.

fields.title: FULLMETAL ALCHEMIST: Brotherhood
fields.description: Two brothers search for a Philosopher's Stone after an attempt to revive their deceased mother goes awry and leaves them in damaged physical forms.

fields.title: TOKYO GHOUL
fields.description: A Tokyo college student is attacked by a ghoul, a superpowered human who feeds on human flesh. He survives but has become part ghoul and becomes a fugitive on the run.

fields.title: BLUE LOCK
fields.description: High school soccer players from across Japan gather for a controversial project designed to create the best and most egoistic striker in the world.

fields.title: SUZUME
fields.description: A modern action adventure road story where a 17-year-old girl named Suzume helps a mysterious young man close doors from the other side that are releasing disasters all over in Japan.

fields.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - The Movie: Mugen Train
fields.description: After his family was brutally murdered and his sister turned into a demon, Tanjiro Kamado's journey as a demon slayer began. Tanjiro and his comrades embark on a new mission aboard the Mugen Train, on track to despair.

fields.title: Your Name
fields.description: Two teenagers share a profound, magical connection upon discovering they are swapping bodies. Things manage to become even more complicated when the boy and girl decide to meet in person.

fields.title: Spirited Away
fields.description: During her family's move to the suburbs, a sullen 10-year-old girl wanders into a world ruled by gods, witches and spirits, and where humans are changed into beasts.

fields.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu No Yaiba Infinity Castle
fields.description: The Demon Slayer Corps are drawn into the Infinity Castle, where Tanjiro and the Hashira face terrifying Upper Rank demons in a desperate fight as the final battle against Muzan Kibutsuji begins.

fields.title: Howl's Moving Castle
fields.description: When an unconfident young woman is cursed with an old body by a spiteful witch, her only chance of breaking the spell lies with a self-indulgent yet insecure young wizard and his companions in his legged, walking castle.

fields.title: Princess Mononoke
fields.description: While seeking to cure himself of a curse, young warrior Ashitaka stumbles into a conflict between the people of Iron Town and Princess Mononoke, a girl raised by wolves, who will stop at nothing to prevent the destruction of her home.

fields.title: My Neighbor Totoro
fields.description: When two girls move to the country to be near their ailing mother, they have adventures with the wondrous forest spirits who live nearby.

fields.title: A Silent Voice
fields.description: A deaf girl, Shoko, is bullied by the popular Shoya. As Shoya continues to bully Shoko, the class turns its back on him. Shoko transfers and Shoya grows up as an outcast. Alone and depressed, the regretful Shoya finds Shoko to make amends.

fields.title: Ghost in the Shell
fields.description: A cyborg policewoman and her partner hunt a mysterious and powerful hacker called the Puppet Master.

fields.title: Weathering with You
fields.description: Set during a period of exceptionally rainy weather, high-school boy Hodaka Morishima runs away from his troubled rural home to Tokyo and befriends an orphan girl who can manipulate the weather.

fields.title: The Boy and the Heron
fields.description: In the wake of his mother's death and his father's remarriage, a headstrong boy ventures into a dreamlike world shared by the living and the dead in search of his missing stepmother.

fields.title: Grave of the Fireflies
fields.description: A young boy and his little sister struggle to survive in Japan during World War II.

fields.title: Wolf Children
fields.description: After her werewolf lover unexpectedly dies in an accident, a young woman must find ways to raise their werewolf son and daughter while keeping their trait hidden from society.

fields.title: Perfect Blue
fields.description: A pop singer gives up her career to become an actress, but she slowly goes insane when she starts being stalked by an obsessed fan and what seems to be a ghost of her past.

fields.title: The Girl Who Leapt Through Time
fields.description: A high-school girl named Makoto acquires the power to travel back in time, and decides to use it for her own personal benefits. Little does she know that she is affecting the lives of others just as much as she is her own.

fields.title: Castle in the Sky
fields.description: Pazu's life changes when he meets Sheeta, a girl whom pirates are chasing for her crystal amulet, which has the potential to locate Laputa, a legendary castle floating in the sky.

fields.title: Jujutsu Kaisen 0
fields.description: The prequel to Jujutsu Kaisen (2020), where a high schooler gains control of an extremely powerful cursed spirit and gets enrolled in the Tokyo Prefectural Jujutsu High School by Jujutsu Sorcerers.

fields.title: I Want to Eat Your Pancreas
fields.description: A high school student discovers one of his classmates, Sakura Yamauchi, is suffering from a terminal illness. This secret brings the two together, as she lives out her final moments.

fields.title: Akira
fields.description: A secret military project endangers Neo-Tokyo when it turns a teenage biker gang member into a rampaging psychic psychopath who can only be stopped by his best friend.
